footer.description: Meet people, share interests, and plan activities with clear details.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Learn how DateNexa helps adults meet, share interests, and plan activities with clear details.
faq.why.title: Why use DateNexa?
faq.why.intro: Meet people around shared interests and make plans with the details clear from the start.
faq.why.people.title: Meet new people
faq.why.people.body: Create a profile, share the things you enjoy, and discover people who may have interests in common with you.
faq.why.activities.title: More than one kind of plan
faq.why.activities.body: Share or explore dating and meetups, car shows, and fitness or health activities in one place.
faq.why.planning.title: Plan with clarity
faq.why.planning.body: Special posts can include details such as the activity, budget, schedule, and area, helping people understand the plan before responding.
faq.questions.title: Questions and answers
faq.a1: DateNexa is a social and dating app for adults to create profiles, meet people, share interests, and explore activity plans.
faq.a2: DateNexa is intended for people aged 18 and over. Please use accurate information in your profile.
faq.q3: What kinds of special posts can I create?
faq.a3: You can choose Dating / Meeting, Car show, or Fitness / Health, then add a title and details for your plan.
faq.q4: What do I need before confirming a date booking?
faq.a4: Complete identity verification and keep enough balance in your account for the amount shown before confirming the booking.
faq.q5: How much will a date or activity cost?
faq.a5: The person creating the plan can provide a budget or remuneration amount. Review the details and amount shown before you agree or pay.
faq.q6: What happens if a confirmed date is canceled?
faq.a6: The payment made for that date will be refunded. You can arrange another date later by creating a new booking and paying its shown amount.
faq.q7: How can I get help if something goes wrong?
faq.a7: Support is available 24/7. If a problem comes up within 24 hours after your date is confirmed, contact the team through Report a problem. We will do our best to help.
faq.q8: How can I stay safe while meeting someone?
faq.a8: Choose what you share, keep passwords and banking codes private, meet in a public place, and tell someone you trust about your plans. Stop contact and report behavior that makes you uncomfortable.
report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Our support team is available 24/7. Contact us if you need help with a confirmed date, a payment, a cancellation, or a safety concern.
report.prefill: Hello DateNexa Support, I need help with a problem.
report.date.title: Problems with a confirmed date
report.date.body: If a problem comes up within 24 hours after your date is confirmed, contact support as soon as possible. Our team will do its best to understand the issue and help resolve it.
report.booking.title: Before confirming a booking
report.booking.body: Complete identity verification and keep enough balance in your account for the amount shown. Review the date, schedule, location, and other details before you confirm.
report.refund.title: Cancellations and refunds
report.refund.body: If a confirmed date is canceled, the payment made for that date will be refunded. You can plan another date later by creating a new booking and paying the amount shown for it.
report.include.title: What to include in your report
report.include.body: Share your booking or post details, when the issue happened, and a short description of what went wrong. Never send your password, one-time login code, full card number, or banking PIN.
privacy.title: Privacy and Community Guidelines
privacy.intro: This page explains what information you may share on DateNexa, how it supports your experience, and the simple steps you can take to stay safe while meeting people.
privacy.promise.title: A thoughtful, respectful community
privacy.promise.body: DateNexa is for adults aged 18 and over. Be honest in your profile, treat people with respect, and only share information you are comfortable making visible to others.
privacy.profile.title: Information in your profile
privacy.profile.body: You choose what to add to your profile, such as your name, photos, interests, and introduction. Profile details help other members discover and get to know you. Avoid including your home address, personal phone number, financial details, or identity documents in public profile fields.
privacy.use.title: How information is used
privacy.use.body: Information you provide may be used to display your profile, support social and dating features, respond to requests, help protect accounts, and improve DateNexa. Do not share your password or one-time login codes with anyone, including someone claiming to be support.
privacy.visibility.title: Who can see your posts
privacy.visibility.body: Check the audience setting before sharing a post. Public content may be seen by people beyond your friends. Even private messages and limited-audience posts can be copied or captured by their recipients, so share thoughtfully.
privacy.location.title: Location and device permissions
privacy.location.body: Only provide a city or approximate area if you want to. If your device asks for location, camera, or photo access, grant permission only when you choose to use a feature that needs it. Meet new people in a public place and arrange your own transport.
privacy.messages.title: Messages and personal boundaries
privacy.messages.body: Keep conversations on the platform until you feel comfortable. Never send money, gift cards, banking codes, or intimate images to someone you have not independently verified. You can end a conversation whenever you want.
privacy.safety.title: Respect, reporting, and community rules
privacy.safety.body: Harassment, threats, impersonation, hate, scams, and sexual content involving anyone under 18 are not acceptable. If a member makes you uncomfortable, stop responding and use the app’s report or block controls when available. Contact local emergency services if you are in immediate danger.
privacy.control.title: Your choices and account details
privacy.control.body: Review the information you publish and update your profile when it changes. Use the privacy and account settings to manage available preferences. If you need help with your account or a safety concern, use Report a problem from the account menu.
privacy.retention.title: Keeping information safe
privacy.retention.body: Use a strong, unique password and sign out on shared devices. Do not use DateNexa to upload another person’s private information without their permission. Remove content you no longer want to share and keep your device software up to date.
privacy.date.title: Date confirmation and payment
privacy.date.body: To confirm a date booking, make sure your account has enough balance for the amount shown and complete identity verification. Please review the date details before confirming.
privacy.cancel.title: Cancellations and refunds
privacy.cancel.body: If a confirmed date is canceled, the payment made for that date will be refunded. You can arrange another date later by creating a new booking and paying the amount shown for it.
privacy.support.title: 24/7 help with a date
privacy.support.body: Our support team is available 24/7. If a problem comes up within 24 hours after your date is confirmed, contact us through Report a problem. We will do our best to help resolve it.
privacy.footer: DateNexa features and data practices may change as the service develops. Please review this page when it is updated. This page describes community expectations and general privacy guidance; it does not replace applicable law or a formal privacy notice.
